structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son and then go to the bank clerk: the page says money left in the עו"ש doesn't always earn interest and the bank must write to me if more than 15,000 ₪ sits there a whole quarter, but it never says how much the bank actually takes from me, and "אין בישראל ביטוח פיקדונות" frightened me.

stuck.why: Its default is 'תשואה 5%' and a big 74,044 ₪ on a page about a current account that 'לא תמיד מקבל ריבית'. I couldn't tell where the 5% comes from.
I came to find out what the bank charges, and it only says 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', with no amount.

stuck.where: Red box at top of screen 3 and 'סיכונים ומה לא מוגן'
stuck.why: Red and 'אין ביטוח פיקדונות' scared me about my deposits. That's where I got tired and mostly stopped.
It compares to 'קרן כספית יומית', which I don't know, so I couldn't tell what the alternative is.

used: Title 'חשבון עובר ושב' and its subtitle
Paragraph on the 15,000.00 ₪ balance and the bank's duty to notify
Sentence that money left in the עו"ש a full quarter belongs elsewhere
כמה זה עולה table: 'דמי חשבון קבועים', 'לפי התעריפון'
מי מציע ומי מפקח: under the Bank of Israel
סיכונים: no deposit insurance, the 250,000 ₪ proposal
skimmed: Calculator inputs (סכום היום, הפקדה חודשית, כמה שנים, תשואה, אינפלציה)
שווה לדעת list with BANK codes
מה האתר לקח בחשבון locked items
unsure_meaning: TXI OQ11, TXI OQ7, BANK OQ9
not_found: How much my bank actually charges me for the current account
How much interest a deposit pays compared with the עו"ש
A simple sentence saying where to move the money safely

findings.what: 'אין בישראל ביטוח פיקדונות' is stated plainly with no reassurance about the safety of ordinary bank deposits. It frightens someone whose money is all in deposits.
The cost section gives no amount, only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'
The calculator defaults to 5% return and shows 74,044 ₪ for a current account that may pay no interest, which is confusing and misleading
A dark red box with a lock and a code, 'TXI OQ11', looks like an error or warning
Every locked item repeats 'עד שהשאלה תיסגר, האתר לא מחשב את זה' and 'חסום: שאלה פתוחה', so I have to reread it each time
Small pale grey text on a dark background is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Notes under the calculator and tables, all screens

findings.what: The chart colours for מס and דמי ניהול are too close, and their numbers are written separately below the chart
The alternative is named only with unfamiliar words, 'קרן כספית יומית' and 'מק"ם'
Codes such as BANK-20 appear next to the facts and mean nothing to me
It doesn't say who runs the site, only 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי'
